predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Excelsior vs Telstar: Expected Goals, Home Fragility & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Telstar's superior midfield creation and Excelsior's zero-clean-sheet home record tilt the matchup toward Draw / Away Win with Over 2.5 goals and both teams scoring.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win behind Telstar's 1.72 away lambda and 44.8% Dixon-Coles win share (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 goals supported by a 3.11 combined lambda and 60.1% model probability (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Excelsior seek home stability against high-xG Telstar's midfield progression.

spf.comment: Covers Telstar's superior xG and 1:2 away-edge script alongside the high-density 1:1 draw branch, whereas a single call ignores either Excelsior's 38.03% blended Elo/DC parity or Telstar's 55.6% big-chance waste rate.

over_under.comment: Backed by 3.11 lambda_total, 60.1% Over 2.5 model probability, and season Over 2.5 rates of 84.6% for Excelsior and 76.9% for Telstar.

score.comment: 1:2 reflects Telstar's higher xG and Excelsior's porous home defense, while 1:1 covers the top 11.2% Poisson stalemate if Telstar's finishing remains wasteful.

goals.comment: 3 goals leads the Poisson distribution at 22.4% ahead of 2 goals at 22.1%, bridging the open 1:2 primary script and tighter 1:1 draw branch.
